The '''LCK 2022 Spring''' Split was the first split of the 2022 season of the [[League of Legends Champions Korea]], organized by Riot Games. The competition ran from January 12 to April 2, with the Regular Season held offline at LoL Park in Seoul and the Grand Final played at KINTEX in Goyang. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Regular Season using best-of-three matches, with the top six advancing to a Single Elimination Playoffs played as best-of-five. The winner qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2022|Mid-Season Invitational]]. The split was played on patches 12.1 through 12.5, with Zeri and Renata Glasc disabled at various points due to balance considerations.

==Format==
*'''Regular Season''' - ''January 12th - March 20th, 2022''
**Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 10th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
*'''Playoffs''' - ''March 23rd - April 2nd, 2022''
** Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2022|Mid-Season Invitational 2022]]
